activities.anchor: To understand the rebellion, know the institution
activities.caption: rebuild the Salon revolt, from gate to market
activities.name: i2eSalonOrder

config.prompt: The rebellion was institutional before it was stylistic — rebuild it:
items: 1863 — the Salon rejects three-fifths of submissions; uproar forces Napoleon III to open the Salon des Refusés
Manet's Déjeuner sur l'herbe scandalises the capital at the Refusés — an alternative channel can exist
1874 — the group exhibits independently at the photographer Nadar's studio
Leroy mocks Impression, soleil levant in Le Charivari — the insult becomes the movement's name
1886 — Durand-Ruel exports the group to New York: dealer, group show, collector, critic
config.why: Audience is manufactured by infrastructure, not found — the circuit built at Nadar's studio is the one every later avant-garde reused.

activities.anchor: Impressionism's look is partly chemistry and infrastructure
activities.caption: pair each tool or law with what it changed
activities.name: i2eToolsMatch

config.prompt: The enabling revolutions — pair each with its effect:

pairs.right: pigment taken outdoors — 'without tubes there would be no Impressionism'
the Seine valley's leisure landscapes an hour from the studios
painting fast, in front of the motif, catching light before it changes
short, unblended strokes that mix optically at viewing distance
shadows painted violet against orange light, not black

config.why: The series — Grainstacks, Rouen Cathedral at different hours — turned all of it into an optical research program: the subject becomes light's effect on the motif.

activities.anchor: painted fast and loose because they
activities.caption: true or false — careless or calculated?
activities.name: i2eCarelessJudge

statements.s: Broken brushwork of unmixed colour was calculated to mix optically at viewing distance.
statements.why: The surface shimmers by design — the speed was the method, not the sloppiness.

statements.s: The violet shadows came from published colour science — Chevreul's simultaneous-contrast law.
statements.why: Studio knowledge: violet shadows against orange light, not black.

statements.s: The Impressionists painted fast and loose because they were careless.
statements.why: Behind every shimmering surface sits a deliberate optical claim.

statements.s: Monet's The Magpie (1869) made the violet-shadow physics visible — and scandalous.
statements.why: The snow-shadow scandal: contemporaries saw violet where doctrine demanded black.

activities.caption: file the facts — the two footnote corrections
activities.name: i2eCanonBuckets

config.prompt: The footnote canon has two holes — file each fact into its corrective:

items.label: flat colour fields, high horizons, cropped framing arrived from ukiyo-e prints
Morisot exhibited in seven of the eight group shows and helped organise them
Cassatt joined in 1877 at Degas's invitation, reversing the male gaze
Eva Gonzalès and Marie Bracquemond complete the four

config.why: A canon that says 'Impressionism: Monet and Renoir' has simply not looked — the formal revolution was partly a cross-cultural import, and the movement's core included its women.

activities.anchor: arrived in Paris from Japanese prints after 1867
activities.caption: pin the debut on the half-century line
activities.name: i2eJaponismePlace

config.prompt: ukiyo-e prints flooded Paris after Japan's Exposition Universelle debut — in what year?
config.why: 1867 — the prints gave Degas his balconies and off-centre baths, Monet his garden and print-collecting obsession, and Van Gogh his copies after Hiroshige.
config.context: Western modernism's formal revolution is partly a cross-cultural import — decades before 'art beyond the West' appeared in any curriculum.

activities.caption: bet first — what was left to paint?
activities.name: i2eTerritoryPredict

config.q: By the 1890s the camera had likeness and the Impressionists had light. The remaining territory Expressionism claimed was —
choices: experience — distortion as truthfulness, how it feels to be alive in it
a return to the Salon's polished moral subjects
config.why: The perception lesson inverted: from how the world looks to how it feels. Munch's Scream bent the landscape's waves to the figure's anxiety; the war tested that sincerity — Kirchner's breakdown, the Nazi 'Degenerate Art' seizure of 1937.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — the road to Cubism
activities.name: i2eCubismSpot

config.prompt: This fin-de-siècle summary contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: The Symbolists proposed the image as idea and dream — suggestion over description.
Art Nouveau's whiplash line dissolved the wall/ornament/fine-art boundaries the Salons policed.
Picasso's Les Demoiselles d'Avignon (1907) preserved the single Renaissance viewpoint out of respect.
Braque joined Picasso in analytic Cubism (1909–12): Cézanne's planes facetted to their logic.
By 1912 the Renaissance window contract was on the floor — voluntarily.
config.correction: Les Demoiselles detonated the inherited picture — multiple viewpoints, compressed space, the African-mask borrowings — and the single viewpoint was abandoned as a principle.
config.why: Impressionism freed colour and brushwork, Post-Impressionism freed structure and expression, Cubism retired the window itself; Futurism (1909) added time and speed to the same destructuring.

activities.anchor: The period's arguments are best practised on three canvases
activities.caption: drag the divider — Monet's sun, with and without hue
activities.name: i2eSunCompare

config.prompt: Impression, soleil levant under cross-examination — drag between the two states:

before.label: In colour (as painted)
before.text: The orange sun and its reflection ride the blue-grey harbour — Leroy sees an unfinished-seeming surface and mocks it: 'Impressionism!' as an insult in Le Charivari.

after.label: Greyscale (the test)
after.text: Remove the hue and the sun nearly vanishes — its value is near-identical to the sky: a deliberate demonstration that hue can do the work of luminosity.

config.why: Chevreul's simultaneous contrast, weaponised: the harbour's silhouettes dissolve into worked atmosphere, and the mockery was a response to exactly this unfinished-seeming surface.
